title: Bug Severity Classification with Fine-Tuned Open LLMs: A Paired Comparison with TF-IDF and CodeBERT Baselines on Eclipse Reports
abstract: arXiv:2610.34127v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Open large language models (LLMs) small enough to run on a laptop are an obvious candidate for automatic bug severity prediction. We measure what they add over cheaper classifiers on one task: assigning one of four Bugzilla severity levels (Critical, Major, Minor, Trivial) to Eclipse bug reports. From a public dump of 361,006 unique Eclipse reports we draw a class-balanced sample of 20,000 rows and compare eleven configurations of nine model types: six TF-IDF classifiers, a fine-tuned CodeBERT encoder, and Llama 3 8B and Qwen 2.5 7B, each run zero-shot and after QLoRA fine-tuning. All eleven are scored on the same 2,000 held-out reports, with bootstrap intervals and McNemar tests. The zero-shot runs reach macro-F1 0.305 and 0.321, below every TF-IDF model (0.430-0.489). The fine-tuned runs reach 0.526 and 0.485, but the zero-shot and fine-tuned setups also differ in checkpoint, serving runtime and decoding, so this gap cannot be credited

translated_title: 基于微调开源大语言模型的漏洞严重性分类：在Eclipse报告上与TF-IDF和CodeBERT基线的配对比较
translated_abstract: 足够小可以在笔记本电脑上运行的开源大语言模型（LLMs）是自动漏洞严重性预测的显而易见的候选方案。我们在一个任务上测量了它们相对于更便宜的分类器所带来的增益：将Eclipse漏洞报告分配到四个Bugzilla严重性级别之一（Critical、Major、Minor、Trivial）。从一个包含361,006条唯一Eclipse报告的公开转储中，我们抽取了一个类别平衡的20,000行样本，并比较了九种模型类型的十一种配置：六个TF-IDF分类器、一个微调的CodeBERT编码器，以及Llama 3 8B和Qwen 2.5 7B（每个都以零样本方式和QLoRA微调后运行）。所有十一个模型都在相同的2,000条留出报告上进行评分，使用自助法置信区间和McNemar检验。零样本运行达到宏观F1值0.305和0.321，低于所有TF-IDF模型（0.430-0.489）。微调运行达到0.526和0.485，但零样本和微调设置在检查点、服务运行时和解码方面也存在差异，因此这一差距不能被归因于……
tldr: 该研究对可在笔记本电脑上运行的开源大语言模型与更便宜的TF-IDF和CodeBERT基线在Eclipse漏洞报告严重性分类任务上进行了配对比较，发现微调后的LLM性能优于传统方法。
en_tdlr: This study presents a paired comparison of laptop-runnable open LLMs against cheaper TF-IDF and CodeBERT baselines on Eclipse bug report severity classification, finding that fine-tuned LLMs outperform traditional methods.
